pages.text: $(l)Fluid Transposer$()$(li)Recipes run in 2 ticks, not 1.$(li)Machines like OpenBlocks tanks fill at 1 tick per bucket (16 ticks for 16-bucket tanks).$(li)Power draw (600 RF/t) exceeds recipe cost (400 RF/t).
$(l)Isotope Separator$()$(li)Upgrading the separator enables simpler, non-spammy TARDIS material routes.$(li)Without the upgrade, complex routing or spam is required.
